identity.summary: Go Schedule 2.0.0 promotes the existing reduced prompt and cursor paths to the current primary mark. Other approved mark geometry remains unchanged.

palette.summary: Existing approved formal and interface colors remain unchanged.

typography.summary: Existing local fonts and outlined wordmarks remain authoritative.

platform_assets.summary: Go Schedule marks, paired lockups, icons, and previews use the simplified primary mark. Every brand gains a distinct approved social image and legacy direct-link aliases.

web_react.summary: The Web and React adapter API and token roles remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API and approved values remain unchanged.

documentation.summary: Brand guides and the hosted site distinguish social images from logo lockups. Brand landing metadata uses exact verified kit image bytes.

recovery.summary: Regenerate and repin affected kits with exact 2.4.0 package checksums. Go Schedule 2.0.0 is an identity migration; other brands gain social assets under their minor versions.
